# ============================================================
#  LOAN APPROVAL · ML STUDIO
#  Interactive Shiny dashboard for the Machine Learning assignment
#  Author: MAKINI CALEB

# ---------- Libraries ----------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny)
  library(shinydashboard)
  library(shinyWidgets)
  library(DT)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(reshape2)
  library(corrplot)
  library(e1071)
  library(caret)
  library(xgboost)
  library(pROC)
  library(gridExtra)
})

# ---------- Global ----------
NUM_VARS <- c("Age", "Income", "Credit_Score", "Loan_Amount", "Employment_Years")
TARGET   <- "Loan_Approved"

# =============================================================
#  Helper functions (defined once, used everywhere)
# =============================================================
detect_outliers_IQR <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR <- Q3 - Q1
  lower <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  upper <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  which(x < lower | x > upper)
}

get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(na.omit(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

make_box <- function(df, vars = NUM_VARS) {
  df[, vars, drop = FALSE] |>
    scale() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(),
                        names_to = "variable",
                        values_to = "value") |>
    ggplot(aes(variable, value, fill = variable)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
}

# =============================================================
#  SERVER
# =============================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ---------- Load data ----------
  raw_data <- reactive({
    df <- NULL
    if (!is.null(input$file)) {
      df <- tryCatch(read.csv(input$file$datapath, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
    }
    if (is.null(df) && file.exists("Loan_Approved data.csv")) {
      df <- read.csv("Loan_Approved data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    if (is.null(df)) {
      ## Fallback synthetic dataset identical in schema to the Rmd
      set.seed(123)
      n <- 592
      income  <- c(runif(240, 17000, 42000), runif(352, 44000, 135000))
      df <- data.frame(
        Applicant_ID     = 1:n,
        Age              = round(rnorm(n, 40, 10)),
        Income           = round(income),
        Credit_Score     = round(rnorm(n, 650, 110)),
        Loan_Amount      = round(runif(n, 5000, 50000)),
        Employment_Years = round(rnorm(n, 10, 5)),
        Loan_Approved    = c(rep(0, 240), rep(1, 352))
      )
      df <- df[sample(nrow(df)), ]
      df$Loan_Approved <- ifelse(df$Income > 43000, 1L, 0L)
      rownames(df) <- NULL
    }
    ## Normalise the target
    lv <- tolower(trimws(as.character(df$Loan_Approved)))
    df$Loan_Approved <- factor(
      ifelse(lv %in% c("yes", "y", "1", "true", "t"), "Yes", "No"),
      levels = c("No", "Yes"))
    df
  })

  # ---------- Cleaned data (outlier treatment) ----------
  clean_data <- reactive({
    df <- raw_data()
    for (i in 1:10) {
      n_rep <- 0
      for (v in NUM_VARS) {
        if (!v %in% names(df)) next
        idx <- detect_outliers_IQR(df[[v]])
        if (length(idx) > 0) {
          df[[v]][idx] <- get_mode(df[[v]])
          n_rep <- n_rep + length(idx)
        }
      }
      if (n_rep == 0) break
    }
    df
  })

  # ---------- Train / test split ----------
  split_data <- reactive({
    set.seed(123)
    idx <- createDataPartition(clean_data()$Loan_Approved, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
    list(train = clean_data()[idx, ],
         test  = clean_data()[-idx, ])
  })

  # ---------- Pre-processing (train-only) ----------
  preproc <- reactive({
    sp <- split_data()
    pp <- preProcess(sp$train[, NUM_VARS], method = c("center", "scale"))
    list(pp      = pp,
         x_train = predict(pp, sp$train[, NUM_VARS]),
         x_test  = predict(pp, sp$test [, NUM_VARS]),
         y_train = sp$train$Loan_Approved,
         y_test  = sp$test$Loan_Approved,
         train   = sp$train,
         test    = sp$test)
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 1. DATA tab
  # =========================================================
  output$vb_rows <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(nrow(raw_data()), "Rows", icon = icon("list"), color = "blue")
  })
  output$vb_cols <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(ncol(raw_data()), "Columns", icon = icon("columns"), color = "green")
  })
  output$vb_dups <- renderValueBox({
    valueBox(sum(duplicated(raw_data())), "Duplicate rows",
             icon = icon("clone"), color = "yellow")
  })
  output$raw_tbl <- renderDT({
    datatable(head(raw_data(), 50),
              options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
  })
  output$str_out <- renderPrint({ str(raw_data()) })
  output$na_out  <- renderPrint({
    na <- colSums(is.na(raw_data()))
    if (all(na == 0)) cat("No missing values in any column.\n") else print(na)
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 2. PREPROCESSING
  # =========================================================
  output$outlier_out <- renderPrint({
    before <- sapply(raw_data()[, NUM_VARS], function(x) length(detect_outliers_IQR(x)))
    after  <- sapply(clean_data()[, NUM_VARS], function(x) length(detect_outliers_IQR(x)))
    res <- data.frame(Before = before, After = after)
    print(res)
    cat("\nTotal remaining outliers:", sum(after), "\n")
  })

  output$bp_before <- renderPlot({ make_box(raw_data()) })
  output$bp_after  <- renderPlot({ make_box(clean_data()) })

  output$stats_tbl <- renderDT({
    df <- clean_data()[, NUM_VARS]
    stats <- sapply(df, function(x) c(mean   = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      sd     = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      min    = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      max    = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
    datatable(as.data.frame(t(stats)) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable"),
              options = list(dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE)
  })

  output$skew_tbl <- renderDT({
    sk <- sapply(clean_data()[, NUM_VARS], e1071::skewness, na.rm = TRUE)
    df <- data.frame(
      Variable  = names(sk),
      Skewness  = round(sk, 3),
      Direction = ifelse(sk > 0, "Right-skewed",
                  ifelse(sk < 0, "Left-skewed", "Symmetric")),
      Magnitude = ifelse(abs(sk) < 0.5, "Low",
                  ifelse(abs(sk) < 1,   "Moderate", "High")),
      row.names = NULL)
    datatable(df, options = list(dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE)
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 3. EDA
  # =========================================================
  output$pie_class <- renderPlot({
    df <- as.data.frame(table(clean_data()$Loan_Approved))
    names(df) <- c("Class", "Count")
    df$Percent <- paste0(round(100 * df$Count / sum(df$Count), 1), "%")
    ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Class)) +
      geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white") +
      coord_polar("y") +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Class, "\n", Percent)),
                position = position_stack(vjust = .5),
                colour = "white", size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "tomato", "Yes" = "steelblue")) +
      theme_void() + labs(title = "Class distribution")
  })

  output$bar_class <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(clean_data(), aes(Loan_Approved, fill = Loan_Approved)) +
      geom_bar() +
      geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)),
                vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "tomato", "Yes" = "steelblue")) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
      labs(title = "Approved vs Rejected", x = "Loan Approved", y = "Count")
  })

  output$hist_cs <- renderPlot({
    x  <- clean_data()$Credit_Score
    m  <- mean(x); md <- median(x); mo <- get_mode(x)
    ggplot(clean_data(), aes(Credit_Score)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = m,  colour = "red",   linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = md, colour = "blue",  linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = mo, colour = "green", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
      labs(title = "Credit_Score distribution (Q13)", y = "Frequency") +
      theme_minimal()
  })

  output$box_income <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(clean_data(), aes(Loan_Approved, Income, fill = Loan_Approved)) +
      geom_boxplot(width = .5) +
      stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "white") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "tomato", "Yes" = "steelblue")) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
      labs(title = "Income by Loan Approval", x = "Loan Approved")
  })

  output$scatter_inc_cs <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(clean_data(), aes(Income, Credit_Score, colour = Loan_Approved)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .7) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("No" = "skyblue", "Yes" = "blue")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = "Income vs Credit_Score")
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 4. CORRELATION
  # =========================================================
  output$heatmap <- renderPlot({
    cm <- cor(clean_data()[, NUM_VARS])
    melted <- melt(cm)
    melted$Var1 <- factor(melted$Var1, levels = NUM_VARS)
    melted$Var2 <- factor(melted$Var2, levels = NUM_VARS)
    ggplot(melted, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
      geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = .5) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 3.5) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "tomato", mid = "white", high = "steelblue",
                           midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "r") +
      coord_fixed() + theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(title = "Correlation Heatmap", x = NULL, y = NULL)
  })
  output$corr_tbl <- renderDT({
    cm <- round(cor(clean_data()[, NUM_VARS]), 3)
    datatable(as.data.frame(cm) |> tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable"),
              options = list(dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE)
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 5. SVM
  # =========================================================
  svm_model <- eventReactive(input$train_svm, {
    pp <- preproc()
    withProgress(message = "Training SVM...", value = 0.5, {
      svm(x = pp$x_train, y = pp$y_train,
          kernel = input$svm_kernel,
          cost   = input$svm_cost,
          gamma  = if (input$svm_kernel == "radial") input$svm_gamma else 1 / ncol(pp$x_train),
          probability = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
    })
  })

  output$svm_summary <- renderPrint({
    req(svm_model()); summary(svm_model())
  })

  svm_preds <- reactive({
    req(svm_model())
    pp <- preproc()
    p  <- predict(svm_model(), pp$x_test, probability = TRUE)
    list(class = p,
         prob  = attr(p, "probabilities")[, "Yes"],
         truth = pp$y_test)
  })

  output$svm_cm <- renderPrint({
    req(svm_preds())
    cm <- confusionMatrix(svm_preds()$class, svm_preds()$truth, positive = "Yes")
    print(cm$table)
  })

  output$svm_metrics <- renderTable({
    req(svm_preds())
    cm  <- confusionMatrix(svm_preds()$class, svm_preds()$truth, positive = "Yes")
    auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(svm_preds()$truth, svm_preds()$prob,
                                          levels = c("No", "Yes"), quiet = TRUE)))
    data.frame(
      Metric = c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "Specificity", "AUC"),
      Value  = round(c(cm$overall["Accuracy"],
                       cm$byClass["Precision"],
                       cm$byClass["Recall"],
                       cm$byClass["F1"],
                       cm$byClass["Specificity"],
                       auc), 4))
  }, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  output$svm_roc <- renderPlot({
    req(svm_preds())
    r <- pROC::roc(svm_preds()$truth, svm_preds()$prob,
                   levels = c("No", "Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
    plot(r, main = "ROC — SVM", col = "blue", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE)
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 6. XGBoost
  # =========================================================
  xgb_model <- eventReactive(input$train_xgb, {
    pp <- preproc()
    x  <- as.matrix(pp$x_train)
    y  <- as.integer(pp$y_train) - 1L
    dt <- xgb.DMatrix(x, label = y)
    withProgress(message = "Training XGBoost...", value = 0.5, {
      xgb.train(
        params = list(objective        = "binary:logistic",
                      eval_metric      = "logloss",
                      max_depth        = input$xgb_depth,
                      eta              = input$xgb_eta,
                      subsample        = input$xgb_subsample,
                      colsample_bytree = input$xgb_colsample),
        data = dt, nrounds = input$xgb_nrounds, verbose = 0)
    })
  })

  output$xgb_summary <- renderPrint({ req(xgb_model()); print(xgb_model()) })

  xgb_preds <- reactive({
    req(xgb_model())
    pp   <- preproc()
    prob <- predict(xgb_model(), as.matrix(pp$x_test))
    list(class = factor(ifelse(prob > .5, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes")),
         prob  = prob,
         truth = pp$y_test)
  })

  output$xgb_cm <- renderPrint({
    req(xgb_preds())
    cm <- confusionMatrix(xgb_preds()$class, xgb_preds()$truth, positive = "Yes")
    print(cm$table)
  })

  output$xgb_metrics <- renderTable({
    req(xgb_preds())
    cm  <- confusionMatrix(xgb_preds()$class, xgb_preds()$truth, positive = "Yes")
    auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(xgb_preds()$truth, xgb_preds()$prob,
                                          levels = c("No", "Yes"), quiet = TRUE)))
    data.frame(
      Metric = c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "Specificity", "AUC"),
      Value  = round(c(cm$overall["Accuracy"],
                       cm$byClass["Precision"],
                       cm$byClass["Recall"],
                       cm$byClass["F1"],
                       cm$byClass["Specificity"],
                       auc), 4))
  }, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE, bordered = TRUE)

  output$xgb_roc <- renderPlot({
    req(xgb_preds())
    r <- pROC::roc(xgb_preds()$truth, xgb_preds()$prob,
                   levels = c("No", "Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
    plot(r, main = "ROC — XGBoost", col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE)
  })

  output$xgb_imp <- renderPlot({
    req(xgb_model())
    imp <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model())
    xgb.plot.importance(imp, main = "Feature Importance", col = "steelblue")
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 7. COMPARE  (robust: handles "only one model trained")
  # =========================================================
  metric_names  <- c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "Specificity", "AUC")
  empty_metrics <- function() setNames(rep(NA_real_, 6), metric_names)

  safe_metrics <- function(preds) {
    if (is.null(preds)) return(empty_metrics())
    tryCatch({
      cm  <- confusionMatrix(preds$class, preds$truth, positive = "Yes")
      r   <- pROC::roc(preds$truth, preds$prob,
                       levels = c("No", "Yes"), quiet = TRUE)
      setNames(c(as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
                 as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"]),
                 as.numeric(cm$byClass["Recall"]),
                 as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"]),
                 as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
                 as.numeric(pROC::auc(r))), metric_names)
    }, error = function(e) empty_metrics())
  }

  output$cmp_tbl <- renderDT({
    svm_ready <- !is.null(input$train_svm) && input$train_svm > 0
    xgb_ready <- !is.null(input$train_xgb) && input$train_xgb > 0

    svm_m <- if (svm_ready) safe_metrics(svm_preds()) else empty_metrics()
    xgb_m <- if (xgb_ready) safe_metrics(xgb_preds()) else empty_metrics()

    df <- data.frame(Metric  = metric_names,
                     SVM     = round(svm_m, 4),
                     XGBoost = round(xgb_m, 4),
                     row.names = NULL)

    datatable(df,
              options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 10),
              rownames = FALSE) |>
      formatStyle(columns = 1:3, backgroundColor = "#f8f9fa")
  })

  output$cmp_plot <- renderPlot({
    svm_ready <- !is.null(input$train_svm) && input$train_svm > 0
    xgb_ready <- !is.null(input$train_xgb) && input$train_xgb > 0

    validate(need(svm_ready || xgb_ready,
                  "Train at least one model (SVM or XGBoost) to see the comparison."))

    svm_m <- if (svm_ready) safe_metrics(svm_preds()) else rep(NA_real_, 6)
    xgb_m <- if (xgb_ready) safe_metrics(xgb_preds()) else rep(NA_real_, 6)

    df <- data.frame(
      Metric = rep(metric_names, 2),
      Model  = rep(c("SVM", "XGBoost"), each = 6),
      Value  = c(svm_m, xgb_m))
    df <- df[!is.na(df$Value), ]

    ggplot(df, aes(Metric, Value, fill = Model)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(.8), width = .7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 3)),
                position = position_dodge(.8),
                vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5) +
      ylim(0, 1.1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(SVM = "#2980b9", XGBoost = "#27ae60")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      labs(title = "SVM vs XGBoost — Test-set metrics",
           y = "Score", x = NULL) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5),
            legend.position = "top")
  })

  # =========================================================
  # 8. PREDICT
  # =========================================================
  pred_result <- eventReactive(input$predict_btn, {
    pp <- preproc()
    newdf <- data.frame(
      Age              = input$p_age,
      Income           = input$p_income,
      Credit_Score     = input$p_credit,
      Loan_Amount      = input$p_loan,
      Employment_Years = input$p_emp)
    scaled <- predict(pp$pp, newdf)

    if (input$p_model == "SVM") {
      req(svm_model())
      p    <- predict(svm_model(), scaled, probability = TRUE)
      prob <- attr(p, "probabilities")[, "Yes"]
      cls  <- as.character(p)
    } else {
      req(xgb_model())
      prob <- predict(xgb_model(), as.matrix(scaled))
      cls  <- ifelse(prob > .5, "Yes", "No")
    }
    list(class = cls, prob = as.numeric(prob))
  })

  output$pred_box <- renderUI({
    r   <- pred_result()
    col <- if (r$class == "Yes") "#27ae60" else "#e74c3c"
    div(style = paste0("padding:20px; text-align:center; border-radius:8px; ",
                       "background:", col, "; color:white;"),
        h2(paste0("Prediction: ", r$class), style = "margin:0;"),
        h4(paste0("Probability of approval: ",
                  round(100 * r$prob, 2), "%"),
           style = "margin-top:10px;"))
  })

  output$pred_gauge <- renderPlot({
    r  <- pred_result()
    df <- data.frame(x = "Approval", y = r$prob)
    ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
      geom_col(fill = if (r$prob > .5) "#27ae60" else "#e74c3c", width = .4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      ylim(0, 1) + coord_flip() +
      labs(title = "Predicted probability of approval", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
